desc: Parse input: Read $N, M, Q$, traveler paths $(S_i, T_i)$, and queries $(L_k, R_k)$.
Precompute the path nodes for each traveler to identify intermediate nodes ($Mid_i$) and endpoints ($S_i, T_i$).
Build a Segment Tree where each leaf $i$ stores the traveler $i$, and internal nodes store the union of travelers in their ranges.
Collects all travelers in the range $[L, R]$ using the Segment Tree.
Adds undirected edges $(S_j, T_j)$ for all collected travelers.
Adds directed edges $(k, S_j)$ with weight -1 for all $k \in Mid_j$ and collected travelers $j$.
Performs a cycle detection (DFS/BFS) on this graph.
Returns `True` if a cycle is found, `False` otherwise.
Use a global `visited` array and a `query_id` to mark visited nodes without clearing the array for each query.
